AdminPrivilege.title: AdminPrivilege
AdminPrivilege.description: Tracks users who have unlocked the hidden Owner Panel using the owner password.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when owner privileges were granted. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Game.title: Game
Game.description: Metadata and HTML5 game payload for a BloxVerse game.

platformId.description: Platform partition identifier for secure collection queries.

description.description: Detailed description and instructions for the game.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail artwork key or image URL.

gameUrl.description: Playable HTML5 bundle content or HTTPS game URL.

category.description: Primary genre category of the game.

creator.description: Display name of the game creator (default: BloxVerse).

plays.description: Total number of game sessions launched.

status.description: Publication status controlled by the Owner.

featured.description: Whether the game appears in the Featured hero carousel.

ownerUid.description: UID of the owner who published the game.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of creation. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last update. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public gaming profile and stats for a BloxVerse player.

totalPlays.description: Total games played by this user.

favoriteGameIds.description: Comma-delimited bounded string of favorite game IDs.

likedGameIds.description: Comma-delimited bounded string of liked game IDs.

recentGameIds.description: Comma-delimited bounded string of recently played game IDs.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of account creation. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of profile update. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

GameReview.title: GameReview
GameReview.description: Player rating and review comment for a specific game.

userName.description: Display name of the reviewing user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when review was submitted. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when review was updated. Clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores verified Owner Panel session registrations.

/games/{gameId}.description: Stores all BloxVerse games, metadata, play/like counters, and HTML5 packages.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores per-user profiles, favorite game IDs, liked game IDs, and recently played game IDs.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Stores user ratings and reviews for games.
